hypothesis.decision_changed_if_positive: Retained baselines: init_s43 139.6632 meV and init_s44 140.6475 meV (50K development, runs pcqm-k1-init-noise-100k-s43/-s44 v1). d43 = MAE(lr2e4_i43) - 139.6632, d44 = MAE(lr2e4_i44) - 140.6475, m = (d43 + d44)/2. POSITIVE: m <= -3.0 and both d < 0. INCONCLUSIVE_SMALL: -3.0 < m <= -1.5 and both d < 0 (a third init is needed before any claim). HARM: m >= +1.5 and both d > 0. INCONCLUSIVE_NOISE: the signs differ and |m| >= 3. NULL: any other outcome. Falsifier: m > -1.5 meV means this setting is not a K1 100K lever at 40 epochs. The paired row bootstrap is reported but does not measure training variance. Secondary, with no gate: s = |MAE(lr2e4_i43) - MAE(lr2e4_i44)| is one more init-noise sample, and s > 3 meV flags the noise estimate as too low. Exploratory ensembles from saved predictions: the lever pair; the cross pairs (lr2e4_i43 + baseline s44) and (lr2e4_i44 + baseline s43) against the same-recipe pair at 134.4781 meV; and the 5-member mean against the 3-init 132.852 meV. No adoption, 500K, full training or continuation.
hypothesis.observed_deficiency: K1 100K has never varied this optimizer setting; module screens are mostly null and the model is variance-limited (3-init ensemble gain 7.7 meV).
